title: One engineering day, by the clock
tagline: The same component on a different scale: clock-only stamps, a linear axis, and the sticker pack. Distance here is real elapsed time, so the gaps are the point.

events.title: Up, no screen
events.summary: Twenty minutes before the first notification of the day.

events.title: First deep block
events.summary: The hardest problem of the day gets the freshest ninety minutes.
keyPoints: One problem, chosen the evening before.
No inbox, no chat, no browser tabs left over from yesterday.
Ends on a written note about the next step, not on a solved problem.
events.impact: Everything else on this rail is arranged around protecting this block.

events.title: Review queue
events.summary: Other people's work, while the context is still warm from the morning block.

events.title: Lunch, outside
events.summary: Away from the desk — the afternoon block depends on it.

events.title: Second block
events.summary: Implementation, not design — the tired hours get the well-specified work.

events.title: Pairing hour
events.summary: The one slot where interruption is the point.

events.title: Shutdown ritual
events.summary: Tomorrow's first block is chosen and written down before the laptop closes.
events.impact: Choosing tomorrow's problem today is what makes the 08:00 block start at 08:00.
